title: Gridded global GDP per capita (PPP), 1990-2024
description: Mirror of Kummu, Kosonen & Masoumzadeh Sayyar's downscaled global GDP per capita (PPP) dataset (Aalto University, Zenodo 18429133, CC BY 4.0). It gives annual values from 1990 to 2024 in 2021 international dollars. The data comes as national, subnational and admin 2 polygons in GeoParquet and PMTiles, and as GDP per capita, total GDP and uncertainty grids in Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF.
